mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative returns in more than 60% of 5-day forward periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that triggers central bank policy support, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 delivers negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for UNRATE rise > 0.5pp is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal broad demand weakness that prompts aggressive monetary policy, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The RSAFS-HOUST interaction fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During post-shock recovery regimes, declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals temporary economic slowdown that triggers central bank intervention, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of INDPRO decline instances during post-shock recovery, or the regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over 3 months indicates labor market strength that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 delivers negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of PAYEMS growth periods, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent price pressures that may trigger rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL increases and FEDFUNDS declines signal central bank policy response to inflation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as growth concerns dominate.
failure_condition: The CPIAUCSL-FEDFUNDS interaction fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In strong consumer demand regimes (high RSAFS), declining housing starts (HOUST) signals potential economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 delivers positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of HOUST decline instances during strong consumer demand, or the regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.03.
